University news

See all news

New research using the James Webb Space Telescope reveals the violent origins of recently quenched galaxies

Researchers have shed new light on why some distant galaxies suddenly stop forming stars.

Read more

New research will enable early detection of Alzheimer’s-related brain changes

A Nottingham scientist has secured funding to bring a new technology to fruition that will identify early brain changes of Alzheimer’s disease, leading to earlier targeted treatments and prevent treatment progression.

Read more

University of Nottingham archive tells the story of Clumber House’s lost grandeur in new National Trust exhibition

Academics and archivists from the University of Nottingham have teamed up with the National Trust to launch a new exhibition series – to tell the tale of Clumber House from its heyday to eventual demolition in the 1930s.

Read more

Could a cooling vest be the answer to weight loss?

Experts from the University of Nottingham are looking for volunteers to take part in a new study investigating whether regular cooling could activate the body’s ‘brown fat’ and potentially help to tackle obesity.

Read more
